entry.title: dotnet/roslyn - Issues & Pull Requests - 2026-10-05
entry.content:
Issues

Created

  • A using directive in every file makes declaration binding quadratic in the number of syntax trees #85922
  • [Known Build Error] The BuildHost process is not responding #85920

Closed

  • RS0016 reported for Razor-generated source files despite .editorconfig exclusions #85888
  • Not properly implemented interface error is behaving wrong #85374
  • RemoteTagHelperProviderService.GetTagHelpersDeltaAsync consumes significant resources while editing #85342
  • C# inside of HTML Comment is not generated in razor.g.cs #85396
  • Blazor webasm - EventCallBack with async handler show compiler error CS0407 or CS0123 #85403

PullRequests

Created

  • Avoid emitting unexpected indirect load instruction in release mode #85929
    Area-Compilers
  • Remove unused Razor content type constants #85928
    Area-Razor
  • Localized file check-in by OneLocBuild Task: Build definition ID 327: Build ID 3096535 #85927
  • [release/insiders] Mirror ProjectData `265321fe`: reader, generator, and build-task projects #85926
  • Avoid quadratic namespace declaration lookup #85923
    Area-Compilers, Community
  • Unsafe evolution: require annotation for layout with pack or size #85921
    Area-Compilers, Feature - Unsafe Evolution
  • Handle missing symlink privileges when running a test locally #85919

Merged

  • Add code actions for documentation diagnostics #85728
    Area-Razor, Next
  • Add logging for a hung BuildHost during shutdown #85908
    VSCode, Area-Razor, Next
  • Fix the language-server publish race #85925
    Next
  • Unify Razor diagnostics to a single endpoint #85867
    Area-Razor, Next
  • Mirror ProjectData `265321fe`: reader, generator, and build-task projects #85851
    Next
  • Handle Razor text views without adapters #85863
    Area-Razor, Next
  • Add folding ranges for documentation directives #85725
    Area-Razor, Next
  • Add semantic-token support for documentation directives #85724
    Area-Razor, Next
  • Add documentation formatting and typing support #85726
    Area-Razor, Next
  • Add documentation completion and snippets #85727
    Area-Razor
  • Ensure we dispose ITextEdits in case we fail to apply them #85884
    Area-Razor, Next
  • Localized file check-in by OneLocBuild Task: Build definition ID 327: Build ID 3095315 #85902
    Next

Updated

  • Bound local test partitions and collect hang dumps across platforms #85849
  • Remove LSP service factory and simplify structure #85832
    VSCode, Area-Razor
  • Split local and Helix test runners #85859
  • Add type suffix options to TypedConstant formatting #85830
    Area-Compilers, Needs API Review
  • Don't copy generated file banners to new documents #85682
    Area-Razor
  • Prevent odd document Uris from causing inadvertent syntax errors #85886
    Area-Razor
  • Switch to Microsoft.VisualStudio.HotReload.Components services #85672
    VSCode
  • Add TargetsTriggeredAfterCSharpCompilation target #85681
  • Unsafe evolutions: require AllowUnsafeBlocks for the safe keyword #85784
    Area-Compilers, VSCode, Feature - Unsafe Evolution
  • Verify semantic symbols in using expression tests #85847
  • Onboard build failure analysis workflow #85046
    Area-Infrastructure, Community
  • File-based apps: load #:ref projects #85260
    Area-IDE, VSCode, Feature - Run File
  • Unsafe evolution: update public API analyzer #85010
    Area-Analyzers, Feature - Unsafe Evolution
  • Fix analyzer collision in framework bootstrap leg #85870
  • Use assembly data for a collection expression that spreads `u8` literal #85911
    Area-Compilers, Community
  • [Add options to] skip formatting in script and style blocks with complex Razor expressions #85142
    Area-Razor
  • Fix close tag completion replacement ranges #85710
    Area-Razor
  • RoslynTools: handle snap commits #85843
